newsitem.title: FINLAND: ATRIA SETS RIGHTS ISSUE OF 4.3 MLN NEW SHRS.
newsitem.headline: ATRIA SETS RIGHTS ISSUE OF 4.3 MLN NEW SHRS.

text.p: Finnish food group Atria Oy said in a statement on Monday it would propose creating a new A series of shares, and a rights issue of 4.3 million new A shares.

Current share- and convertible bond holders would be entitled to subscribe a total of 4.3 million new A series shares, each with a nominal value of 10 markka, Atria said in a proposal to an extraordinary shareholders' meeting.
Three old shares will entitle holders to one new share at a subscription price of 40 markka.
Atria also proposed that holders of current KI series shares would be able to convert those shares to A series shares.
It said it would seek a listing for the new A shares on the Helsinki stock exchange. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
